rows.target_rule: After a user creates a meeting series, the recurring meeting template opens in draft mode by default.
In a PDF viewed from the web interface, an attachment with a displayed preview does not appear in the attachment bullet list.
Playbook task text containing Markdown is displayed with Markdown formatting.
When automatic theme mode is selected, OpenProject must match the operating system’s contrast setting.
A user without User management permissions can edit their own profile through My Profile.
A user with channel permission to create checklists can create a checklist in that channel without separate playbook access permissions.
Adding a custom field to a document without specifying a value must preserve any existing value of that field on the document.
Setting GIF picker to Disabled in Compose settings removes the GIF picker from the compose box.
The OpenProject date picker must display a yellow banner warning that manual scheduling will ignore existing relations.
When a chat poll is anonymous, participants cannot see who voted for each option.
The web upload interface accepts MP2T video files with the .m2t extension.
A recipe-pool rule using a Food Label includes only recipes with an ingredient bearing that label.
When a user accepts an invitation, their initial settings must match the defaults configured at acceptance time.
A user must have Organize group data permission to create a new food through the web interface.
Changing the work package table configuration automatically updates the results displayed in the table.
Structure (S) permissions must not be available in table-level access rules.
In a new Mattermost deployment, users can create threads by default.
Users can configure a default reminder for all events in a calendar through that calendar's settings.
When inviting a new member, the web interface must allow selecting an existing user role, group, or placeholder user's permissions as the basis for the new user's permissions.
By default, newly created work packages display numerical IDs from a single instance-wide sequence, regardless of project.
A user may join a user group using its plus icon only if they have permission to join it.
Users can set work package start and finish dates by typing into the corresponding date fields.
Only public or web-public channels can be selected as default channels for new users.
When a work package description contains page breaks, the exported document splits its contents into separate pages at those breaks.
Jira import must preserve status names as literal text, including names such as constructor or proto.
An archived project must not appear as a selectable option in the project selector.
Switching a work package from manual to automatic scheduling displays a warning banner stating that its dates are not determined by child work packages.
Users can configure whether automated notices are automatically marked as read.
Enabling “Pin channel to top of left sidebar” in a channel’s Personal settings places that channel at the top of the left sidebar.
Typing a user's name in the search box offers a suggestion for direct messages with that user.
Users cannot enable On-Demand Tables in new Grist documents.
A device password is accessible in the web interface only when it is created.
When inviting a guest, the user must select at least one channel before the invitation can be submitted.
When dragging an archived multi-selection, the destinations highlighted in green must be exactly Remaining and all existing Workspaces.
When a user pastes a URL matching a reverse-enabled linkifier into the compose box, it automatically becomes linked text corresponding to that linkifier.
Duplicating a board with either duplication option excludes the source board's existing board and card activity events from the duplicate's activity history.
The Quarantine for Review action is available only for messages in public or private channels, not in direct or group messages.
When shared sprint fields are read-only due to permissions, the project-specific sprint goal remains independently editable.
Pressing Shift+F10 in the grid opens the context menu.
When the feature is enabled, channel admins creating a channel see a field labeled “Default category (optional)”.
The project's More (three dots) dropdown menu must include an "Add a subproject" option.
The timezone preference defaults to Automatic.
When leaving an already-muted public channel joined through a membership policy, the confirmation dialog shows Cancel and Leave channel instead of Mute instead.
Channel messages are automatically translated into the user's preferred language.
Standard Duplicate links display as duplicates or is-duplicated-by according to their direction.
Toggling “Show week of year (ISO 8601)” in the board Date popup immediately updates the week-number display without requiring Save.
With Food enabled, shopping-list entries for 1 cup of cheese and 2 cups of cheese must combine into one entry showing 3 cups of cheese.
A user with permission to administer a private channel must also subscribe to that channel before they can subscribe other users to it.
Only administrators can see the options to set a project as a template or remove it from templates.
When the Add Swimlane popup opens, Below selected swimlane is selected by default.
On every plan, a document's combined attachment and data storage must not exceed 1GB.
When project wikis are disabled globally, the Project wiki settings page remains visible and displays a notice that wikis must first be enabled globally in administration settings.
After a user selects 'Set default: Collapse' for a parent page, its nested pages must be collapsed when the document is reopened.
A user may grant superuser status to another user only if the acting user is a superuser.
Documents whose processed text is empty or contains only whitespace are skipped.
When a user mentions someone who is not a member of the channel, the web interface prompts them to add that person to the channel.
Dropping multiple selected boards onto Home must display "Please select only one board" while leaving Home and the selection unchanged.
Reordering a field in either display-order list changes its position on the corresponding card surface without changing its position on the other surface.

When either membership restriction is enabled, a non-admin inviter can add a user to a board only if that user shares an organization or team of an enabled kind with the inviter or an active board member.
Changing the section display order for an opened card must not change the minicard's section display order.
Using breakout rooms in a web call divides the call into smaller groups.
A linked work package is displayed as a full-width card only when linked using a slash command on an empty line.
When the user selects the 1 Board option for multiline text, the whole text is kept as one board title.
Deleting a folder under normal conditions moves it to the trash bin instead of permanently deleting it.
The {{doc_title}} placeholder cannot be used in title assignment.
When anonymous team and channel URLs are enabled, the web team creation flow assigns the team URL automatically without prompting the user to choose it.
Clicking Restart at the bottom of the tutorial popup refreshes the page and discards unsaved changes.
When Sort favorites up is enabled in Mail appearance settings, favorite messages appear in a separate section above the rest of the message list.
When suggestions are enabled, opening a document automatically opens a copy for both signed-in and signed-out users.
Searching for channels:archived returns only messages the user received in archived channels.
The folder feature toggle under Account Settings > Features is labeled "Folders".
A screen reader must announce Markdown content beginning with '# ' as a heading rather than reading the hash symbol aloud.
After a user closes their document fork, visiting the document's Direct URL automatically redirects them to their saved fork.
A persistent notification for an urgent message containing an @mention stops repeating when its recipient acknowledges, reacts to, or replies to the message.
In Full path or folder search mode, a query matching part of an asset's original path must include that asset in the results.
A channel's Moderation permissions must allow users to configure who can delete their own messages in that channel.
Attachments restricted by attribute-based permissions must appear in messages with the placeholder "Files not available" and subtitle "Access to files is restricted based on attributes".
Users can submit a status update without setting a reminder for the next status update.
When Google blobs is selected, emoji released after 2017 must display in the modern Google style.
The user subscription typeahead must exclude users already subscribed to the target channel.
A message the user has permission to edit must display the pencil edit icon.
Confirming Delegate access makes the shared mail account appear in the selected delegate's account list marked as delegated.
The button to generate a channel email address must be hidden when the user lacks permission to send messages to that channel.
When administrators require topics in channel messages, users cannot send channel messages to the “general chat” topic.
When creating an external library, the web interface must allow assigning it to exactly one user.
Each meeting agenda section must display the sum of the specified durations of its contained items.
The channel settings screen must place the "Who can subscribe anyone to this channel" setting under "Advanced configurations".
The web interface must allow a user to start a discussion thread with a title and description.
The conversation settings Meeting section must offer a CSV upload option for bulk inviting email participants.
After a logged-in reader stars a public board they do not belong to and reloads, that board appears in their Starred overview.
Any user can unsubscribe themselves from a channel they belong to.
The project’s attachment visibility setting determines whether the attachments option appears in the Files tab of its work package detailed views.
Creating a Calendar event with a Talk conversation as its location creates a conversation visible in the conversation list if none exists yet.
Duplicating a board does not copy the source board's existing board or card activity events into the duplicate.
Conditional formatting added under 'Row Style' must apply across the entire matching table row.
A team may have at most 10 billing managers.
Synchronizing an upstream title or description change updates the corresponding card text only if it still matches the last synchronized source value, preserving locally edited text otherwise.
Guests using a magic login link can log in through the web interface without entering a password.
Conversations in a private channel are visible to users who have been granted access to that channel.
